channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Aron Baynes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Aron Baynes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Mills says, before repeating himself.

“I don't say that necessarily as a good thing. We definitely have got some work to do in this area, I believe, but for now it's full focus on Tokyo,and a gold medal would do wonders for our program, as at least a starting point. There's a prestigious feeling within our program that needs to be a joint effort between the playing group and Basketball Australia to make sure when -- we've lost 'Bogues' [Andrew Bogut], obviously -- I step away, when Joe Ingles steps away, 'Delly' [Matthew Dellavedova], [Aron] Baynes -- that that program is still elite, if not even more levels up, as it should be.”

Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Eric Koreen:Gregg Popovich on Aron Baynes:

“He’s a wonderful human being. He’s a tough nut on the court. … Off the court, he’s a sweetie pie.”

Gregg Popovich on Aron Baynes, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ekoreen.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes:

“It was a sad day for me when we traded him. … Great impact in our locker room, great impact on the court, great impact on our coaching staff. Just, like, a pro’s pro. And all-time energy. One of the best energy raisers I’ve ever been around.”

Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes, Jan 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Jay King:Jaylen Brown:

“Baynes, that’s my guy. He’s crazy as hellbut I’m excited to see him.”

Jaylen Brown on Aron Baynes, Nov 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
James Jones:

“This year we have from Frank [Kaminsky], Dario [Saric], Cheick [Diallo]...we can play Deandre [Ayton] at power forward if we need to, with Aron Baynes as our center.”

James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton, Sep 19, 2019. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Jay King:Kyrie on starting Baynes and Horford:

“We need rim protection. We’ve been relatively small not in height but in terms of our physical presence out there when we have some of our wings guarding bigs ... I know Coach had a great game plan of putting both those guys out there...”

Kyrie Irving on Aron Baynes, Mar 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Al Horford, Aron Baynes
item.description:
“I’m excited right now because our team is getting healthy, we haven’t had Baynes and Horford, in the lineup very much this year,”

Danny Ainge on Al Horford, Aron Baynes, Mar 28, 2019. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Steve Bulpett:Stevens on Baynes (ankle):

“He had an MRI [Thursday] that actually came back more positive... I've been told, pending the results of it, he's not an automatic out on Sunday (v San Antonio). I'd say he's unlikely, but he's not automatically out.”

Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes, Mar 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @SteveBHoop.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes:

“I think he's a tremendous communicator. He's a tremendous talker. He's very prideful. He plays to exhaustion. We've got a lot of tough guys on our team, but I think they all will tell you Baynes is one of the toughest we've all been around.”

Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes, May 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Al Horford, Aron Baynes
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“You can’t have two better leaders than Al Horford and Aron Baynes.”

Brad Stevens on Al Horford, Aron Baynes, May 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes:

“All you see are the highlights and the dunks on Baynes. You don’t see the thousands of times that he stops the ball. Like, he just doesn’t care if he ends up on a highlight. He just does his job well.”

Brad Stevens on Aron Baynes, May 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I’m excited about the playoffs. I really am. Like, Terry Rozier and Shane Larkin, this is their opportunity. And Jaylen [Brown] and Jayson [Tatum] and Marcus Morris and [Al] Horford and [Aron] Baynes and Greg Monroe, I mean, the whole group. These guys are looking forward to playing in the playoffs. And we have the luxury to give them a little bit of rest without taking them completely out of rhythm in these last four games, which is very rare to be able to do heading into the playoffs.”

Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes
item.description:
Jay King:Stan Van Gundy on Aron Baynes and Marcus Morris:

“I've coached in this league a fairly long time now and those are two of my favorite guys. I mean, tough, team-oriented guys who will try to do whatever it takes to win.”

Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Nov 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Aron Baynes
item.description:
Vincent Ellis:Jennings on Baynes:

“I like it when he’s pissed off. I don’t like it when he’s laughing. When he’s pissed off, it’s on.”

Brandon Jennings on Aron Baynes, Jan 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @Vincent_Ellis56.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Aron Baynes, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Dan McCarney:Pop on Duncan's 25K:

“I told Aron Baynes, 'It's no big deal. If you shot as much as Tim, you'd have 25,000 too.'”

Gregg Popovich on Aron Baynes, Tim Duncan, Nov 15, 2014. Source: Twitter @danmccarneysaen.
